faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges is 50 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $4.90/pc (50 pcs starter tier), $3.30/pc (500 pcs tier), and $2.50/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges is $135 Maltese Cross Die. Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges?
faqs.answer: Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges is custom-engineered from Solid Brass / Heavy Zinc using Curved Maltese Cross + Hard Enamel Banner Panels, sized around 65×65×3.5mm at approximately 56g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Gold / Rhodium Silver / Dual-Plated. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with Heavy Safety Catch + Optional Serialization. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges completes in 12–15 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Fire Department Maltese Cross Badges can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
